correctness.rationale: The two-wing clique proof exhausts faces uniformly for all m>=2. The dihedrally invariant short-arc cover has intersections equivariantly contractible under their stabilizers, so the nerve quotient is homotopy equivalent to an interval. One orbit of equilateral triangles remains; its S3 quotient disk has the boundary quotient as a deformation-retract edge, so it contributes no quotient homotopy. Barycentric orbit-chain computations over F2 and F3 for m=2..5 corroborate but do not substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact all-parameter homotopy classification at the first nontrivial critical Rips scale and distinguishes full-dihedral from rotation-only symmetry. The result explains why order-m torsion disappears through genuine stabilizer geometry, a conclusion not supplied by rational homology, Euler characteristic, or finite data alone.
